title: Sorting out the chronology and Purvis in Barnet's later band
summary: Willard checks the order Shreveport, Kilgore, New York, Shreveport, West Coast against Chilton; Purvis later played in Barnet's band at the Paramount Hotel and Albany.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, it sounds like it wasn't dull at all with him, right? In addition to playing Shreveport, it says here that he was with you in Kilgore, is that right?
No, he was never in Kilgore with me.
That was before he had been -- it was the second trip to Shreveport that he --
You went to Shreveport then to Kilgore, then back to New York, then back to Shreveport.
And then to the west coast.
Well, they have it in a different order here. And they have a lot of material about Jack Purvis in the Chilton book, but none of your stories.
Yeah, it mentions his having been in

Jack later played in my band at the -- when we left the -- well, he joined me at the Paramount Hotel. He wasn't with me when I opened there, but before we closed he was with us. Then we went to -- oh, up in Albany, to the New Kenmore Hotel. He was on that job with the band. That's the last I ever saw of him.
You went from Shreveport, then, to the West Coast.
To Texas with him and then to the West Coast.
